observations: Black motorcycle/scooter-style bike, worn paintwork, scratches on body panels.
Photo 1 shows embossed text 'JINCHENG' on the front fairing/headlamp shroud.
Handlebar grips wrapped in mismatched red and blue tape, suggesting repair or replacement.
Photo 2 shows the front headlamp housing cracked/broken with a red reflector piece dislodged.
A 'FOR SALE' paper tag is taped to the body in all three photos.
Chrome rear carrier rack and exhaust pipe visible, both show light surface wear.
No visible chassis number, engine number, or registration plate in any photo.
No photo or video showing the engine running, kick-start attempt, or odometer reading.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows 'JINCHENG' embossed on the fairing; 'Lucky' model name not independently visible in any photo.
Photo 2 shows a cracked/broken front headlamp housing and general surface wear; not consistent with 'very good condition'.

claims.claim: working perfectly except the kick brush don spoil
claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the engine running or the kick-start being used; claim of 'working perfectly' is also internally inconsistent with admitting a kick-start fault.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run reliably at all, beyond the admitted kick-start fault.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine being started and idling/running.

risks.risk: Kick-start mechanism is confirmed faulty; electric start status unknown.
risks.proof: A clip showing attempt to start via kick and/or electric starter.
risks.if_unproven: priced as kick-start non-functional, electric start unverified

risks.risk: Front fairing/headlamp housing damage visible in photo 2 could indicate a prior crash with possible frame or fork damage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the fork, frame welds, and full headlamp assembly from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as crash-damaged with unknown structural impact

risks.risk: No registration plate, chassis number, or engine number visible, so legal ownership and matching papers cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the chassis/engine number plate and the vehicle particulars/registration document.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified ownership, documentation risk

risks.risk: Tyre tread depth and brake condition cannot be judged from the angles given.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres' tread and brake pads/discs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn tyres/brakes needing replacement

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running (kick and/or electric).
Close-up photo of the chassis number and engine number plates.
Photo of the vehicle registration/particulars document.
Close-up photos of the front fork and frame near the damaged headlamp area.
Close-up photos of tyre tread and brake components.
response.reason: The bike is identifiable by the visible Jincheng branding, but the admitted kick-start fault, unverified running condition, and visible front-end damage mean it must be priced at worst case until proof of a running engine and structural integrity is provided.
